title: Pressure Washing in Lake City, FL | Soft Wash Too
description: Pressure washing and soft washing in Lake City, FL for siding, stucco, roofs, driveways, and storefront walks. Mildew and pollen removal before painting.
h1: Pressure Washing and Soft Washing in Lake City, FL
heroIntro: Mildew, algae, and pollen removed from Lake City homes and storefronts using the right pressure for each surface. We also handle the wash before every repaint.

questions: What is the difference between soft washing and pressure washing?
Will pressure washing damage my siding or stucco?
How do I get pollen stains off my house?

body: Not every surface can take high pressure. Soft washing uses low pressure and a cleaning solution that kills mildew and algae at the root. It is the right choice for painted siding, stucco, screens, and roofs. Pressure washing at higher pressure suits concrete driveways, sidewalks, and pavers. Choosing the right method for each surface is what separates pressure washing in Lake City, FL from blasting a wall and hoping for the best. Too much pressure on stucco or soft wood can gouge the surface or force water behind it.

sections.h2: What builds up on Lake City buildings
body: Shaded north walls in subdivisions grow green and black streaks. Spring pollen leaves yellow film on window ledges and porch ceilings, which we cover in our guide to cleaning Florida pollen stains. Storefronts near the highway pick up road grime and exhaust film that dulls the paint. Mildew that looks like dirt is usually alive, so it has to be killed, not just rinsed. Our mold on siding guide explains how to tell them apart.

sections.h2: Washing as the first step of a paint job
body: Every exterior repaint we do starts with a wash, because paint applied over chalk, mildew, or pollen won't adhere well. When washing is part of a repaint, the surface gets time to dry before primer goes on. If you plan to paint within the year, ask about pairing the wash with exterior painting in Lake City.
bullets: House washing for siding and stucco

body: Plants near the work area are rinsed before and after cleaning. Outlets, fixtures, and door thresholds are checked so water stays outside. Commercial washing can be scheduled before opening or after closing. Cleaning solutions are chosen for each surface, and we manage runoff instead of letting it wash across the yard. Pool decks and screened lanais are handled carefully so screens stay intact. If the wash turns up failing caulk, peeling paint, or soft wood, the crew lead photographs it so you know where the next problems will start. Our company-wide pressure washing and soft washing page has more detail. For everything else we offer here, return to the Lake City overview.

faqs.q: Will pressure washing damage my Lake City home's siding?
faqs.a: Painted siding and stucco are soft washed at low pressure. High pressure is reserved for concrete and pavers.

faqs.q: Can you clean a roof without damaging it?
faqs.a: Yes. Roofs are soft washed with low pressure and a cleaning solution, not blasted.

faqs.q: Do you wash a house before painting it?
faqs.a: Always. Washing and mildew treatment are standard prep on every exterior project, and the surface dries before priming.

faqs.q: Can you wash a storefront outside business hours?
faqs.a: Yes. Commercial washing can be scheduled early, late, or on weekends.
